item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.32)] Apple Says iPhone 18 Pro Max Units That Lost AT&T Service Need Replacement, Not a Fix
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.32)
Apple has confirmed that a cellular connectivity issue affecting some iPhone 18 Pro Max devices on AT&T's network requires unit replacement rather than a software fix for already-affected phones. While iOS 27.0.1 and a carrier settings update act as preventive measures, they cannot restore service on devices already in SOS mode. The cause of the fault, which primarily impacts the US iPhone 18 Pro Max model using a Qualcomm modem, has not been disclosed, and Apple states only a "small number" of users are affected despite thousands of complaints.
